profileLandingPage.aboutSection:
Most people think buying a home is about finding granite countertops and open floor plans.

After inspecting thousands of homes across Metro Atlanta, I'll tell you the truth:

Cosmetic renovations routinely hide catastrophic structural defects.

A $12,000 kitchen flip can easily conceal $45,000 in foundation deflection, bootleg electrical wiring, and active sewage backups.

Years ago, I watched solo inspectors rush through 4,000 sq. ft. properties with a flashlight in 45 minutes, miss major fire hazards, and leave innocent families holding the bag.

I founded Foresight Home Inspections to end that standard forever.

Here is how we operate differently:

1. THE TWO-INSPECTOR PROTOCOL: We deploy two certified inspectors on every single property. One audits the building envelope, roof, crawlspace, and foundation while the second audits electrical panels, plumbing fixtures, and HVAC systems simultaneously. Double the scrutiny, half the on-site time.

2. SCIENTIFIC DIAGNOSTICS STANDARD: Every full inspection includes infrared thermal radiometric thermal imaging and FAA Part 107 4K drone roof photogrammetry at zero extra charge. We don't guess with binoculars.

3. SAME-DAY LEVERAGE: In Georgia's competitive 5-to-8 day due diligence windows, waiting 48 hours for a report kills deals. We deliver high-definition narrative reports the exact same evening, backed by up to $35,000 in warranty coverage ($10,000 Elite Master Warranty + $25,000 InterNACHI Honor Guarantee).

Whether you are acquiring a historic Craftsman in Inman Park, a new construction estate in Alpharetta, or a commercial multi-family property in Midtown, my team ensures you never walk into a transaction blind.

Hindsight is expensive... Choose Foresight.
